summary: Iteration 92 - Frontend testing of Comprehensive User Agreement features for InfoPilot Explorer. Tested: 1) User Agreement Modal with 4 tabs, 2) THREE age confirmations required, 3) Prohibited Content tab with nuclear/terrorism/bio-chem/psychological warfare restrictions, 4) User Conduct tab with no-impersonation and no-contact-minors checkboxes, 5) Search blocking for prohibited content with warning, 6) Compact Ad Banner, 7) Data Source Toggle. All features verified working.
